newsitem.title: USA: Minor earthquake hits central Chile, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Minor earthquake hits central Chile, no damage.

text.p: A minor earthquake rattled central Chile on Sunday but no serious damage or injuries were reported, according to the U.S. Geological Survey in Golden, Colorado.
Geophysicist Stuart Koyanagi, whose organisation monitors quakes worldwide, said the quake struck at 3:53 p.m. EDT (1953 GMT) about 55 miles (88 km) southeast of the capital Santiago.
The quake measured 5.3 on the open-ended Richter scale.
